clue.text: Having lost heart, call on tennis player to become superhuman

indicators.note: losing its heart means the middle letter of the word for call is dropped

parts.note: to call out is to cry
Bjorn Borg, the Swedish tennis champion

explanation.surface: A tennis star is summoned and turns into a superhero after losing his nerve.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Having lost heart' removes the middle R from CRY, leaving CY; 'on' simply joins it to BORG.
explanation.definitionFit: A cyborg, part human and part machine, has powers beyond a normal person's, so it is fairly called superhuman.

clue.text: Ten wandering into African country sang rhythmically

indicators.note: the word into signals that one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: Chad is a country in central Africa

indicators.note: wandering suggests the letters of ten roam into a new order

explanation.surface: Ten travellers roaming into an African nation broke into rhythmic song.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wandering' scrambles 'Ten' and 'into' sets the result inside the country; the surface's ten wanderers are just letters on the move.
explanation.definitionFit: To chant is to sing or intone words to a steady repeated rhythm.

clue.text: See 24
Soft toy dog chewed up during slowing of music

indicators.note: during means one piece happens inside the span of the other

parts.note: rall. is the abbreviation of rallentando, a gradual slowing in music

indicators.note: something chewed up is mangled, so the letters of dog are scrambled

explanation.surface: A dog chewed up a soft toy while the music was slowing down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chewed up' scrambles 'dog' and 'during' places it within the musical term; rall. is the score marking for rallentando, which solvers outside music may not know.
explanation.definitionFit: A rag doll is a floppy cloth doll, a classic soft plaything for children.

clue.text: Romantic thing may please, pinching girl's bottom

parts.note: may and can both express permission

indicators.note: pinching means nipping something in, so one piece is gripped inside another

parts.note: to please someone is to delight them

indicators.note: the bottom of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: A cheeky romantic gesture involves pinching a girl's backside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pinching' puts L, the last letter of 'girl's' given by 'bottom', inside DELIGHT, after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Dining by candlelight is the stock setting for romance, so the glow itself is a romantic thing.

clue.text: Hollow suggestion male artist brought up

indicators.note: in a down clue, brought up means the whole sequence is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a tip is a hint or suggestion
RA, Royal Academician, stands for an artist

explanation.surface: A man passes on a suggestion that an artist raised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought up' reverses the whole run TIPMRA.
explanation.definitionFit: The armpit is the hollow under the arm where it joins the shoulder.

clue.text: Seeming unsure, I'd upped cycle

indicators.note: in a down clue, upped means the letters of I'd are raised and so read backwards

parts.note: The Ring is Wagner's operatic cycle, Der Ring des Nibelungen

explanation.surface: Someone hesitant admits they turned up the pace on a bike ride.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upped' turns ID into DI. Cycle looks like a bicycle, but it means a series of operas.
explanation.definitionFit: Dithering means wavering and failing to decide, which shows someone appears uncertain.

clue.text: Time when 22 1 down in song?

parts.note: the two linked answers said together sound like the opening words of a famous show tune from South Pacific, whose last word names a time of day

explanation.walkthrough: Fish and sang rhythmically together give a phrase that, said quickly, mimics 'Some enchanted ...', a Rodgers and Hammerstein song title.
explanation.definitionFit: The song is Some Enchanted Evening, and the evening is the time of day it names.

clue.text: Kitchen utensil, useless thing one embraces with passion?

parts.note: a lemon is a dud, something that does not work
someone who hugs hard is jokingly a squeezer

explanation.surface: A kitchen gadget is mocked as a useless thing that hugs with passion.
explanation.definitionFit: A lemon squeezer is a kitchen tool for pressing juice out of citrus fruit.

clue.text: Ticket for all to see, though not allowed

parts.note: a tab is a ticket or label, and also a bill
U is the film certificate meaning suitable for universal viewing

explanation.surface: A ticket on public display, though such things are forbidden.
explanation.walkthrough: U is the British film rating for a film anyone may watch.
explanation.definitionFit: Tabu is a variant spelling of taboo, meaning forbidden by custom.

clue.text: Issue of pensions, for instance, needing intelligence

definitions.meaning: a matter concerning grey-haired older people, like pensions, read playfully
brainpower, the stuff of the brain

explanation.definitionFit: Grey matter is brain tissue, used for brains or intelligence; read literally it is a topic for the grey-haired.

clue.text: Office boss takes on priestess

parts.note: a boss is a stud, a raised knob on a surface
Io was a priestess of Hera in Greek myth

explanation.surface: An office manager takes on a priestess as a new hire.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boss' looks like a manager but is the ornamental knob.
explanation.definitionFit: A studio is a workroom, an artist's or broadcaster's place of work, so a kind of office.

clue.text: Talk about spinachlover's love for cooking ingredient!

indicators.note: talk about signals that the words are spoken and judged by their sound

parts.note: Popeye, the cartoon sailor who eats spinach, loves Olive Oyl

explanation.surface: An exclamation praising the sweetheart of a cartoon spinach eater as a key kitchen item.
explanation.definitionFit: The oil pressed from olives is a basic ingredient for frying and dressings.

clue.text: Fresh euros sold out

indicators.note: out signals the letters of euros sold are put out of order

explanation.surface: Brand-new euro notes have all been sold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fresh' looks like the anagram signal, but it is the definition; 'out' does the rearranging.
explanation.definitionFit: Something with no smell is fresh in the sense of free of any stale odour.

clue.text: When flogged, mean sadhu showing no remorse

indicators.note: flogging beats something about, so the letters of mean sadhu are thrashed into a new order

explanation.surface: A cruel holy man is beaten but shows no regret.
explanation.walkthrough: A sadhu is a Hindu holy man.
explanation.definitionFit: To be unashamed is to feel no guilt or regret for what one has done.

clue.text: Fly has first to nestle inside rug

indicators.note: inside puts one piece within another

parts.note: rug is slang for a wig or toupee

indicators.note: first to points at the opening letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A fly tucks in first to nestle inside a rug.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first to' gives N, which goes 'inside' WIG.
explanation.definitionFit: To wing it is to fly, as birds do on wings.

clue.text: For example, 24 2 to take an unnecessary risk?

definitions.meaning: the linked Greek tragedy about the Titan who stole fire is a drama involving fire
an idiom for courting danger needlessly

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means taking foolish risks, and the tragedy about the fire-stealing Titan is literally a stage drama with fire in it.

clue.text: Before taking right, one cutting left going over roundabout

indicators.note: in a down clue, going over means the first part sits above the next
cutting means slicing into, so these pieces go inside the word for left

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship
I is the Roman numeral for one
a roundabout is circular, like the letter O

explanation.surface: A driver takes a right turn, cutting left over a roundabout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking' and 'cutting' together put R and I inside PORT, giving PRIORT; 'going over' puts that above O.
explanation.definitionFit: Prior to means earlier than, which is what before means.

clue.text: Substitute certain to include label, or sent back

indicators.note: to include means one piece holds another inside it

parts.note: sure means certain

indicators.note: sent back means the run of label and or is read in reverse

parts.note: a tag is a label
taken as written

explanation.surface: A stand-in is surely labelled, or else returned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sent back' turns TAGOR into ROGAT, which goes inside SURE.
explanation.definitionFit: A surrogate is someone or something standing in for another, a stand-in.

clue.text: Ship in the pink over a cold expanse of water

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means the first part sits above the next
in means the ship letters go inside the flower

parts.note: rose is a shade of pink
SS is the abbreviation for steamship

explanation.surface: A ship in fine health sails over a cold sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the pink' looks like an idiom for healthy, but pink just gives ROSE.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ross Sea is a deep bay of the Southern Ocean off Antarctica, icy cold water.

clue.text: Record written up about old soldier

indicators.note: about means one piece goes round the other
in a down clue, written up means the word for record is read from the bottom

parts.note: a report is a written record

explanation.surface: A record is written up concerning an old soldier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'written up' turns REPORT into TROPER, and 'about' puts it round O.
explanation.definitionFit: A trooper is a private soldier, especially in a cavalry or armoured unit.

clue.text: Draw round instruction on letter — move cautiously

indicators.note: round means one piece encircles the other

parts.note: a tie is a drawn match
PTO, please turn over, is written at the foot of a letter's page

explanation.surface: Drawing a circle round a note on a letter, then moving off carefully.
explanation.definitionFit: To tiptoe is to walk on the toes, quietly and carefully.

clue.text: See 16
Fish seeks mullet primarily in barbershop!

indicators.note: in means a letter is put inside the shop

parts.note: a salon is a hairdressing shop

indicators.note: primarily means first, picking the opening letter

explanation.surface: A fish wants a mullet haircut at the barber's.
explanation.walkthrough: 'primarily' gives M, which goes 'in' SALON. A mullet is a hairstyle as well as a fish, which suits the barbershop.
explanation.definitionFit: The salmon is a well-known river and sea fish.

clue.text: See 4
Terribly ponderous, the bum Greek tragedy

indicators.note: terribly suggests the letters are badly mangled into a new order

explanation.surface: A slow-moving play is called rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bum' is British slang for rubbish, not a backside.
explanation.definitionFit: Prometheus Bound is an ancient Greek tragedy attributed to Aeschylus.

clue.text: Yawn, producing good copy

parts.note: to ape is to copy

explanation.surface: A yawn produced by copying someone else's.
explanation.walkthrough: 'producing' simply links the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: To gape is to open the mouth wide, as in a yawn.

clue.text: Pots of parlour pooches p*** off!

indicators.note: off means the named letter is taken away

parts.note: poodles are pampered dogs kept in parlours
the asterisked word is the letter p, playing on a censored swear word

explanation.surface: Lots of pampered dogs are told to get lost in a censored outburst.
explanation.walkthrough: 'p*** off' looks like a censored rude dismissal, but it says remove P.
explanation.definitionFit: Pots and oodles both mean a great deal of something, informally.

clue.text: Do something to break supporting element

indicators.note: to break means one piece splits the other open

parts.note: being for something is supporting it
to act is to do something

explanation.surface: Take action to break a supporting element.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Do something' gives ACT, which goes 'to break' FOR.
explanation.definitionFit: A factor is an element or component that contributes to a result.
